info.title: Traccar Reporting Service API
info.description: REST API for the Traccar Reporting Service, providing endpoints for generating and delivering various report types.

get.description: Retrieves combined report data for specified devices or groups within a time range

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device IDs to include in the report

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Group IDs to include in the report

parameters.name: from

positionId.description: Position identifier this event is associated with

maintenanceId.description: Maintenance identifier this event is associated with (for maintenance events)

attributes.description: Additional attributes associated with the event
